**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: sector breadth is modestly positive while large-cap Tech and several Financials are broadly BELOW TREND, producing mixed signals; Leadership: Broad (Top 5 span 5 sectors). Major divergence present (multiple large names show 1W vs 1M mismatches) — watch for trend break.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**

Communication strong: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, TTWO (1W: +5.89% | 1M: -13.04%) RECOVERY; Sector breadth: positive (10 stocks). **3. Which sectors are lagging?**

Technology weak: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION; Sector breadth: negative (24 stocks). Consumer Discretionary soft: AMZN (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND, TTWO RECOVERY; Sector breadth: slightly negative (14 stocks).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY, INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY, NEM (1W: +6.44% | 1M: -1.48%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -10.08%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated: Narrow (3/5 Financials).

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY, INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY, FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND — note PYPL/INTU/CRM are RECOVERYs (1W up, 1M down) indicating tactical bounces, not confirmed trend changes.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is weak with large-cap pressure and mixed internals: MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION while CRM (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: negative (24 stocks). Action: monitor for confirmation; divergences are major.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are underperforming: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND, AXP (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND, PYPL RECOVERY. Sector breadth: negative (20 stocks). Action: reduce exposure to cyclical bank risk until stabilization.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare remains constructive: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.13% | 1M: -0.26%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: positive (17 stocks). Action: favor defensive/earnings-confirmed names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Maintain balanced positioning given NEUTRAL regime; favor Healthcare, Utilities and select Energy/Materials names (LLY, PFE, CEG, XOM) while reducing exposure to large-cap Tech and beaten Financials until trend confirmation. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; be selective given leadership breadth.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Utilities, Healthcare, Energy (breadth positive; Utilities & Energy showing confirmed ABOVE TREND names). BEARISH: Financials, Technology (breadth negative; large-cap Tech and most banks BELOW TREND). Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch Tech downside confirmation: NVDA sustainment below this week’s lows would reinforce continued downside; AAPL failing to hold its 1M uptrend (current CORRECTION) would signal broader Tech stress; JPM needing a weekly base to avoid further bank weakness; NFLX closing above this week’s gap would confirm momentum continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+80): LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND — news (oral GLP‑1/Olumiant) confirms price strength. PFE (+65): PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND — clinical news confirming upward move.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
PYPL (-55): PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY — bearish headlines clash with strong 1W rally (distribution risk). INTU (-50): INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY — analyst downgrade but short-term bounce; watch follow-through. IBM (-45): IBM (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND — bearish sentiment confirming price weakness. JPM (-45): JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND — lawsuit/overhaul headlines align with weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND and NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) and large-cap Financials remain BELOW TREND. Key risk: major 1W vs 1M divergences (PYPL, INTU, AAPL, CAT) and mixed news sentiment require confirmation before re-risking core exposures.
